nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer(address _to, uint _value) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
UniswapExchange.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) payable; performs allowance/balance updates with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
UniswapExchange.ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist bypass logic against owner, canSale, tradeAddress and computed UNI pair.
UniswapExchange.condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; sale-count and min/max sale gating.
UniswapExchange.delegate(address a, bytes b) payable; owner-only, executes arbitrary delegatecall.
UniswapExchange._mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue); privileged backdoor that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists it.
UniswapExchange.init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken); owner-only sale parameter configuration.
UniswapExchange.batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) payable; owner-only batch transfer with unchecked arithmetic and duplicated events.
UniswapExchange.setTradeAddress(address addr); owner-only setter for tradeAddress whitelist.
UniswapExchange.pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; computes deterministic Uniswap pair address via init code hash.
UniswapExchange constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; sets owner=msg.sender, mints supply, grants infinite allowance to UNI router.
address private owner; privileged account used across access checks.
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; mutable token balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; spend approvals.
mapping(address => bool) private canSale; whitelist that bypasses transfer restrictions.
uint256 private _saleNum; allowed number of sales per sender.
mapping(address => uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-sender sale counter.
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used by _mints and init.
uint public totalSupply; total token supply set in constructor.
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowances and transfers.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary caller-supplied address and calldata inside delegate().
Unchecked subtraction/addition of allowance and balanceOf inside transferFrom (pragma 0.5.x, no SafeMath).
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and balance subtraction inside batchSend.
Unrestricted balanceOf[spender] overwrite (addedValue * 10**decimals) plus canSale whitelisting inside _mints.
Parameter addedValue of _mints(); arbitrary mint amount.
